service.name: Gala and award night entertainment
service.serviceType: Live music for galas, fundraisers, award dinners and annual meetings
service.description: Live music for nonprofit galas, association award nights, chamber annual dinners and company award ceremonies in Denver and across Colorado: reception acts, dinner ensembles and dance bands that work around remarks, auctions, videos and walk-ups, on one contract.

faqs.q: Do you play during the live auction and the paddle raise?
faqs.a: Only if the auctioneer wants music low under the bidding, and most don't. The usual plan is silence through the auction, a short piece as each lot closes if the program calls for it, and the band back in when the auctioneer hands the microphone back. The auctioneer gets a microphone of their own.

faqs.q: How loud is the music at dinner?
faqs.a: Quiet enough that a table of ten talks across it, and the band stops for every speaker. After the last award it plays like a dance band, up to whatever the venue allows. Give us the venue's sound cap and curfew when we sign and the night is built under them.

faqs.q: What do you need from the venue?
faqs.a: A dock time and an elevator window if it's a hotel, one or two dedicated 20-amp circuits depending on the size of the act, the sound cap and curfew if there are any, and the run of show with the program's cues on it. The W-9, the certificate of insurance and one itemized invoice come with the contract.

faqs.q: Do you work with our emcee and auctioneer?
faqs.a: Yes. The run of show is planned with whoever is running the program, the emcee gets an announcement microphone of their own, and the bandleader takes cues from the emcee on the night. If your emcee is a board member doing it for the first time, we're glad to walk through it with them before the doors open.

faqs.q: How far ahead do galas book entertainment?
faqs.a: Committees usually work a year out, because the venue and the honorees are settled first and the entertainment follows. Tell us the date and the venue, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.
